title: Draw each item’s move between two dates as an arrow from start to end.
rule: Use shift arrows when the reader needs where each item started, where it ended and which way it moved: one row per item, an arrow from the earlier value to the later one on one scale with a labeled center, and the national row set apart above the states (Rule 14.7 for party data). On a phone, where the arrows crowd, the chart ranks the items by the size of the shift and draws each as a stem from zero, with the later value in words on its row.
use_when: The reader asks which places moved, which way and how far, between two elections or two years.

use_instead.when: Only the size of each move matters, ranked
The places should be read as a map of the country
The reader looks up each place’s figures more than the shape of the moves

text: An arrow carries three facts at once: the start, the end and the direction, so a reader sees both that every state moved one way and how far apart they still stand. Party names in words and position carry the sides, never color (Rule 14.7).
why.basis: Design judgment, from the chart system our founder and editor approved in November 2026

builders: Form shift-arrows: node work/build/chart-kit/oa-chart.mjs build s11; encode from, to and shift, and the form draws the phone ranking under 480 px.
